notes.title: Sig.NULL receives FREEdom
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

This game is pretty old.
First released at 2014 as free game.
Then with small update at 2016 here at Steam.
HD version was released at 2020 on XBOX and  at 2023 at Steam.

This year, I decide to make this game free.

There are three reasons:
[olist]
[*]Now I'm working on my brand Half-Face Games which will contain only free games.
[*]I believe every game should become free after sell time was over.
[*]I was wrong, selling my games. I make games not for money. But to give players new gaming experience. I'm sure, that "buying game" is a form of supporting developer, who made games you love to play. I don't want to force players support me anymore. If they want, they can donate, for example.
[/olist]

Everyone will be able to play Sig.NULL for free starting September 12th.
Maybe free game will attract new players and our community will grew.

notes.title: Updated to HD
notes.content:
This is a HD version of game, which was released 3 years ago at XBOX. This version has many improvements, mostly with visuals and usability. But also I had forced to remove some features. The full change-list bellow.

Good news:
[list]
[*] Remastered visuals
[*] Improved UX with various hints (for buttons and in-game elements)
[*] New levels selection - it's more easy to navigate now
[*] Now user can view his best solution for each level with "replay record" option.
[*] Added Russian language
[*] Full HD support
[*] New music for some locations (e.g. Infected and Unallocated sectors)
[*] Added intro and outro cutscenes
[/list]

Bad news:
[list]
[*] Old save files are incompatible with new version of the game, sorry =(
[*] Removed Achievement "HTTP to HTTPS" which had no sense. All other achievements are the same except "#100 (Continue)" which now can be obtained by completing "Rules" puzzle at the main menu.
[*] Removed in-game leaderboards. But I'm ready to return them by massive users request.
[/list]

Despite this all, I hope, all of you will enjoy with updated version of this game!
